title: MSA-OFF
description: MSA-OFF for BMW MGU ID7 (diesel DDE9). One checkbox: permanently disable the automatic start-stop (MSA2) via the car's own diagnostic link, exactly like ISTA's service function: UDS routine 31 01 F5 29 on the DDE (0x12), verified by read-back 22 F5 29. Read-only until the checkbox is pressed twice (arm + confirm). Re-enabling stays with ISTA (service function Activate MSA) on purpose.
